summary: PicoCELA filed a Form 6-K reporting two equity events: About Investment Pte. Ltd. converted 5,000,000 Class A preferred shares into 5,000,000 common shares on September 30, 2026, following its July 16, 2026 purchase of 20,000,000 preferred shares. Separately, the board shortened the restricted-share transfer restriction from 20 to 10 years, and Chairman Hiroshi Furukawa and COO Hideaki Horikiri surrendered 1,166,666 and 3,833,334 restricted shares as treasury shares. Post-transaction, 9,613,805 common shares and 15,000,000 preferred shares remain outstanding, totaling 24,613,805 voting rights. No special-situation transaction terms, premium, advisor, or regulatory clock were disclosed; watch dilution, insider forfeitures, and any follow-on conversions.
